lead.zh: 导轨结构 FEA 验证。

body.en: Hand calculations ran about 4.5× optimistic. A back rib and a front lip nearly tripled the load capacity; one out-of-plane span still needs closing out.
body.zh: 手算比实际乐观约 4.5 倍。加背肋与前唇后承载力接近三倍；面外最差跨位仍待收尾。

body.en: S1–S5 family extracted; stop margins calibrated per ring ([0, 2, 4, 8] mm ladder); whole-family peaks 0.24–0.42 mm.
body.zh: S1–S5 全族提取；止程余量逐环阶梯标定（[0, 2, 4, 8] mm）；全族峰值残差 0.24–0.42 mm。

lead.en: Arch stops promoted to the model.

body.en: Two devices diverged on the same URL — a legal sliding mode, not a bug. Dual-end slot clamping + fixed-step integration; 168 tests green.
body.zh: 同一 URL 两台设备形态分岔——是合法的滑移模态，不是算错。双向槽端钳制 + 定步积分；168 项测试绿。

body.en: Next.js scaffold, content pool with build-time validation, four routes; LinkageFigure live on the homepage with SSR first frame.
body.zh: Next.js 脚手架、带构建期校验的内容池、四条路由；LinkageFigure 上主页，含 SSR 首帧。

body.en: Independent 3D kernel; three-tendon 120° tentacle; orbit camera. First version vetoed on feel — fascia anti-twist bracing brought lateral drift 38.5→1.2 px.
body.zh: 独立 3D 内核；三肌腱 120° 触手；轨道相机。首版手感被否——fascia 抗扭斜杆把横向漂移压到 38.5→1.2 px。

body.en: The physical S4 ring (angulated scissor arch + crank-slider) as a solver preset — kernel untouched, 7 new tests.
body.zh: 真机 S4 环（角化剪式拱 + 曲柄滑块）作为求解器实例——内核零修改，新增 7 项测试。

lead.zh: 四杆连杆 M4 封盘。

body.en: Release damping, live coupler tracing, engineering captions; 36 tests. Sealed: bugfixes only from here.
body.zh: release 阻尼、耦合曲线实时描绘、工程标注；36 项测试。封盘后只修 bug。

body.en: All five rings now turn on one shaft — stepper, 3:1 belt, 6 mm D-shaft. Gravity and friction set the torque, not inertia.
body.zh: 五环共轴：步进电机 + 3:1 皮带 + 6mm D 轴。扭矩由重力与摩擦决定，不是惯性。

body.en: About ¥300 all in, with existing kit stock excluded so nothing gets bought twice.
body.zh: 含条件项总计约 ¥300；已有库存明确排除，避免重复采购。

body.en: Line-length law, Tufte margin notes, Swiss grid — desktop-first case-study grid decided.
body.zh: 行长定律、Tufte 边注、瑞士网格——案例页确定桌面优先网格。

body.en: Math derivations, API, tolerances, milestones — the single source of truth for the solver line.
body.zh: 数学推导、API、容差、里程碑——求解器线的唯一权威来源。

lead.zh: 实验设计修复，感知系统冻结。

body.en: The physiological contrast that did not survive the arithmetic was cut rather than fudged, and the measurement battery trimmed to fit a small sample. Sensing scope frozen at six channels.
body.zh: 算不过来的那项生理对比直接砍掉，不做勉强；量表裁剪到匹配小样本。感知范围冻结在六个输入通道。

body.en: Two softboxes and a paper infinity curve. For static parts, the quality of the light matters far more than the quantity of it.
body.zh: 两盏柔光箱 + 纸质无缝背景。拍静物时，光的质量远比亮度重要。

lead.en: Servo, fastener and touch standards settled.
lead.zh: 舵机 / 紧固件 / 触摸三线定标准。

body.en: Reuse the stock servo spline instead of reinventing it; oversize printed holes to meet reality; and accept that one electrode returns one number — position costs channels.
body.zh: 舵盘花键沿用原厂而非自造；打印孔位放大以迁就实际收缩；一个电极只给一个读数——要分位置就得加通道。

body.en: Mobility analysis showed one rod cannot pin the arch down; an apex guide can. Ring geometry frozen on that basis, with 3–26% more travel per ring.
body.zh: 自由度分析表明单杆锁不住拱，加顶点导轨才行。环几何据此冻结，各环行程增益 3–26%。

body.en: Method — sensing, validated scales, coded behavior — is what separates this from aesthetic “robot death” work. The behavior engine is both the weakest link and the biggest lever.
body.zh: 方法（生理传感、验证量表、行为编码）是与「机器人之死」类美学作品的分界线。行为引擎最弱，也最有杠杆。

body.en: Three NEMA17s on TMC2209 drivers — the cheaper drivers simply lack the current headroom, so there was no trade to make.
body.zh: 三台 NEMA17 配 TMC2209——更便宜的驱动器电流不够，没有折中余地。

lead.en: Clearance rules for printed moving parts.

body.en: A joint seized at 0.4 mm and taught the rule: sintered parts need more room than the drawing suggests, and axial clamping kills a joint faster than a tight bore.
body.zh: 0.4mm 卡死一个关节，换来一条规则：烧结件要的余量比图纸直觉更大，而轴向夹紧比孔紧更致命。

body.en: A shoulder screw does two jobs at once — journal and gap-setter — which removes a tolerance stack instead of managing it.
body.zh: 塞打螺丝一件两用——既是轴颈又定间隙，直接消掉一条公差链，而不是去管理它。

lead.en: Appendages cut from three to one plus two.
lead.zh: 触手从三条改为一主两须。

body.en: One expressive arm and two reflexive feelers beat three weak arms. Restated in the same pass: this is not biomimicry — the machine should look like a machine, so that behavior stays the variable.
body.zh: 一条表达性主臂 + 两条反射性触须，胜过三条都不强的臂。同时澄清：这不是仿生——机器就该看起来像机器，行为才是自变量。

lead.zh: 手指连接件与肌腱定案。

body.en: Slide-in pins keyed across the pull direction, so the hand comes apart for repair instead of being sealed shut by press fits.
body.zh: 哑铃销侧滑装入、键槽垂直于拉力方向——手指能拆开维修，而不是被压配死死封住。

body.en: Five candidates compared; angulated scissors won for one reason — it is the only one that stays parametric all the way into simulation.
body.zh: 五个候选比下来，角化剪式胜出只因一点：它是唯一能一路参数化到仿真的方案。

lead.zh: 欠驱动手指刚体模拟跑通。

body.en: Four tapered segments, three tendons. The friction that makes the joints close one after another is not a defect to design out — it is what reads as alive.
body.zh: 四段渐变指节 + 三根肌腱。让关节先后闭合的摩擦不是要消除的缺陷——它读起来正是生命感。

body.en: A full Kangaroo definition taken apart component by component. Every mechanism study after this one stands on it.
body.zh: 把一套完整的 Kangaroo 定义逐个电池拆开读懂。之后所有机构研究都站在这上面。

lead.en: Form framework and first study protocol.
lead.zh: 物理形态框架 + 实验方案初版。

body.en: Four structural components and a ranked function list; sessions of roughly 37 minutes across four accelerated life cycles. The measures were chosen before the build, not after it.
body.zh: 四大结构组件与功能优先级；单场约 37 分钟、四个加速生命周期。测量工具在动手造之前就选定，不是事后补。

body.en: When does a person attach to a non-living thing, and what surfaces at loss. An early drift toward maximizing grief was corrected — death is the instrument, not the point.
body.zh: 人在什么条件下对非生命体产生依恋，失去时又如何表现。早期「最大化悲伤」的偏移已纠正——死亡是工具，不是目的。

body.en: Three concepts came out of watching people mourn an AI companion that a model update had taken away. This is the one that stuck.
body.zh: 看着人们哀悼一次模型更新带走的 AI 伴侣，产出三个候选概念。留下来的是这一个。
